settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Server settings of Vaultwarden. Values that the module manages itself (domain, single sign-on, sign-ups, proxy) are not shown.
settings.group_duo: Global Duo settings (users can override them)
settings.reset_confirm: All settings saved on this page are deleted and Vaultwarden uses its defaults again. Users, vaults and the values managed by the module are not affected.
settings.smtp_mode_disabled_help: Vaultwarden sends no emails. Email-based features such as email 2FA are unavailable.
settings.smtp_mode_smarthost_help: Host, port, encryption and login are taken from the smarthost of this cluster and follow its changes. Sender and the remaining options are set below.
settings.smtp_mode_custom_help: All SMTP values are set below.
settings.no_smarthost: The cluster has no smarthost configured. Set it up in the cluster settings to use it here.
settings.smtp_mode_applied: Email mode applied. Vaultwarden was restarted.

users.title: Users
users.help: Vaultwarden users. Accounts are created when someone signs in with single sign-on for the first time, so invitations are not needed.
users.confirm_remove_2fa: Remove all two-step login methods of {user}?
users.confirm_deauth: End all sessions of {user}? The user has to sign in again.
users.confirm_disable: Disable {user}? The account is locked until it is enabled again.
users.confirm_delete_sso: Delete the single sign-on link of {user}? The next SSO sign-in creates a new link.
users.confirm_delete: Delete {user} and all data of this account? This cannot be undone.
users.confirm_resync_all: All clients fetch their data again the next time they connect. Useful after restoring a backup.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.confirm_delete: Delete the organization {name} with all its collections and shared entries? This cannot be undone.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.revocation_warning: Automatic access revocation is disturbed. Check the module status.
diagnostics.idp_update_required: The IdP module is too old: all Vaultwarden sessions are ended until the IdP module is updated.

admin.title: Advanced admin page
admin.help: The original Vaultwarden admin page for everything this module does not cover. Sign-in uses your NS8 account.
admin.tab_open: The admin page is open in another tab. Keep this page open: it keeps the admin session alive.
admin.invalid_answer: Invalid answer when opening the admin page.
admin.renewal_failed: The admin session cannot be renewed and ends shortly.
